name: Aso Yukari
source:
[Spoiler][url=/c34601]Aso Kiriri's[/url] biological mother. Worked at the Busujima Laboratory.

Became a living dead after being exposed to Lemures gas in an accident.

Her consciousness was transferred to a Humanoid Operating Machine named [url=/c85766]Sori Ayuka[/url] by Kurushima Michiya.[/spoiler] 

Fond of lotus-scented flavor capsules.

[Edited from the in-game profile]
